summary: John Deere Owner Trust 2026-B filed a 424B5 prospectus for a $782.95 million asset-backed securitization of agricultural and construction equipment loans. The offering comprises six tranches of notes with coupons ranging from 3.981% to 4.61% and final payment dates from July 2027 to May 2033. The trust is issuing the notes, with John Deere Receivables LLC as depositor and John Deere Capital Corporation as sponsor/servicer. Credit enhancement includes a 1.00% reserve account and subordination of the certificate. This is a routine ABS issuance, not a special situation.
